'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Siege of Mariupol]]
****[[Russia]] declares victory in capturing the city of [[Mariupol]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/may/21/russia-ukraine-war-moscow-declares-victory-in-battle-for-mariupol-steel-plant-russia-halts-gas-supplies-to-finland-live?page=with:block-628878548f08d18babe11374#block-628878548f08d18babe11374 (''The Guardian'')]
**[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs into law a bill that would provide $40 billion in military and economic aid for [[Ukraine]], replenish stocks of U.S. equipment sent to Ukraine, fund [[United States European Command|European Command]] operations, and address [[2022 food crises|the global food crisis]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/21/politics/biden-signs-ukraine-bill/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/after-delay-congress-sends-40-billion-ukraine-aid-package-biden-2022-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Maghreb insurgency]]
**[[Mali War]]
***An elderly [[Italians|Italian]] couple and their son are [[kidnap]]ped by [[jihadist]]s in Southern [[Mali]]. A [[Togo]]lese citizen is also reported to have been kidnapped along with the Italians, but authorities say that they are unable to confirm if this is true. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/three-italians-kidnapped-southern-mali-church-says-2022-05-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A 17-year-old member of the [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] is killed and another is injured during clashes with [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in [[Kafr Dan]], [[Jenin Governorate]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-forces-kill-palestinian-teen-militant-during-clash-group-says-2022-05-21/ (Reuters)] 
'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 global supply chain crisis]]
**[[2022 United States infant formula shortage]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs the Access to Baby Formula Act, a bill aimed at expanding access to [[baby formula]] in the [[United States]]. [https://thehill.com/news/administration/3496582-biden-signs-bill-to-protect-access-to-baby-formula-amid-shortage/amp/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]], [[Finland–Russia relations]]
**Russia's [[Gazprom]] suspends [[natural gas]] exports to [[Finland]] over Finland's refusal to comply with Russia's [[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute#Demand of payment in rubles|demand that gas be paid for in rubles]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russia-stops-finland-gas-flow-over-payments-dispute-2022-05-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Weather of 2022]]
**[[May 2022 Canadian derecho]]
***At least nine people are dead after a [[derecho]] moves across portions of [[Central Canada]]. [https://www.cp24.com/news/at-least-seven-dead-thousands-without-power-after-storm-1.5914228 (CP24)] [https://ottawa.ctvnews.ca/what-is-a-derecho-climatologist-explains-saturday-s-powerful-storm-1.5914534 (CTV News)]
**At least 57 people are dead after severe flooding in eastern [[India]] and [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/world-asia-61540944 (BBC News)]
*Two workers are killed in an accident at the Khoemacau [[copper mine]] in [[Botswana]]. Authorities temporarily shut down the mine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/work-suspended-botswanas-khoemacau-copper-mine-after-accident-kills-two-2022-05-21/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are killed after a [[building collapse]] in [[Lagos]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-61540619 (BBC News)]
*Three people are killed and more than 30 are injured in a bus crash on the motorway near [[Mealhada]], [[Portugal]]. [https://www.today90.com/at-least-three-dead-and-four-seriously-injured-in-a-bus-accident-in-portugal (Today 90)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tamil Nadu]]
*****[[Tamil Nadu]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#Sublineages and BA.2 subvariant|Omicron BA.4 variant]] in a 19-year-old woman. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/covid-19-tamil-nadu-reports-first-case-of-omicron-ba4-variant/article65442229.ece/amp/ (''The Hindu'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports its first case of the Omicron BA.4 variant in a person who recently travelled to the [[Middle East]]. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2022/05/21/2182727/philippines-detects-omicron-subvariant-ba4-filipino-who-returned-middle-east/amp/ (''The Philippine Star'')]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Switzerland]] and [[Israel]] confirm their first cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/5/21/israel-switzerland-report-first-monkeypox-cases-as-virus-spreads (Al Jazeera)] 
**[[Greece]] and [[Norway]] report their first suspected cases of monkeypox. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/norway-warns-possible-monkeypox-infections-oslo-2022-05-21/ (Reuters)] [https://www.keeptalkinggreece.com/2022/05/21/monkeypox-greece-first-case-tourist-uk/ (Keep Talking Greece)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Australian federal election]]
**[[ABC News (Australia)|ABC News Australia]] declares that [[Prime Minister of Australia|Australian Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] and the current [[Government of Australia|government]] have been defeated by [[Anthony Albanese]] and the [[Australian Labor Party]]. However, the number of seats to declare a [[Majority government|majority]] or [[Minority Government#Australia|minority government]] is uncertain. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-05-21/labor-anthony-albanese-projected-to-win-2022-federal-election/101084660 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Science and technology'''
*An unusually early [[heat wave]] in [[Southern France|Southern]] [[France]] continues to set all-time high records for May, with some communities reporting temperatures as high as {{conv|36.7|C|F}}. [https://www.ladepeche.fr/2022/05/21/chaleur-les-300c-largement-depasses-en-occitanie-ce-samedi-des-records-hallucinants-battus-10309693.php (''La Dépêche du Midi'')] [https://www.leparisien.fr/meteo/meteo-encore-des-records-de-temperature-battus-ce-samedi-avant-des-orages-dimanche-21-05-2022-QKUJEQLBGJCMZNWEJKOQIWCVSI.php (''Le Parisien'')]
*An early heat wave in the [[United States]] sets all-time high records for May 21 in several cities in [[Texas]], [[Mississippi]], [[Virginia]], [[Maryland]] and [[Delaware]], and ties them for some other areas, particularly in the [[Northeastern United States|Northeast]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/05/21/us/weather-east-coast-heat/here-are-some-the-places-where-the-heat-set-records-today (''The New York Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021–22 UEFA Women's Champions League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Olympique Lyonnais Féminin|Olympique Lyonnais]] defeat [[FC Barcelona Femení|Barcelona]] 3–1 in the [[2022 UEFA Women's Champions League Final|final]] at [[Juventus Stadium]] in [[Turin]], Italy, to win their eighth [[UEFA Women's Champions League]] title. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/05/21/football/lyon-barcelona-champions-league-final-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2021–22 EuroLeague]]
**In [[basketball]], [[Anadolu Efes S.K.|Anadolu Efes]] defeat [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] 58–57 in the [[2022 EuroLeague Final Four|championship game]] at [[Štark Arena]] in [[Belgrade]], Serbia, to win their second [[EuroLeague]] title. [https://www.dailysabah.com/sports/basketball/anadolu-efes-downs-real-to-clinch-back-to-back-euroleague-titles (''Daily Sabah'')]
